_help: Layout of the new student screen (test phones only). Edit titles, sub lines, colours (bg / fg / chip), card order, which tab a card is on, the Today list and the 30-day challenge tasks. The app picks up changes when it opens or on pull-down refresh - no new build. Do not change an id.

challenges.title: Spoken English
tasks: Say your name, course and college in 3 sentences. Record it and listen once.
Learn 5 new words and use each one in a sentence.
Describe your morning in 30 seconds.
Introduce a friend in 4 sentences.
Read one news headline aloud, slowly and clearly.
Say 5 sentences with I am, I have and I like.
Describe your college in 30 seconds.
Tell the story of your last weekend.
Practise greetings for morning, afternoon and evening.
Describe your favourite food without naming it.
Say 5 sentences in the past tense.
Explain how to make tea in 5 steps.
Read a paragraph aloud and record it.
Describe the picture in front of you for 30 seconds.
Ask 5 polite questions you would ask a new classmate.
Talk about your hometown in 40 seconds.
Say 5 sentences in the future tense.
Give directions from your hostel or home to college.
Speak for 1 minute about your best friend.
Practise 5 tongue twisters, slowly.
Explain your favourite subject to a child.
Describe your dream job in 5 sentences.
Tell a short story with a beginning, a middle and an end.
Practise a phone call: ask for some information politely.
Give your opinion on mobile phones in class, with 3 reasons.
Introduce yourself the way you would in an interview.
Say why a company should hire you, in 30 seconds.
Describe a problem you faced and how you solved it.
Speak for 2 minutes on any topic you like.
Record your self-introduction again and compare it with day 1.

challenges.title: Interview ready
tasks: Write your 30-second answer to Tell me about yourself.
List 3 strengths with one example each.
List 2 weaknesses and what you do about them.
Research one company you like and write what it does.
Practise your answer to Why should we hire you?
Prepare your answer to Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Read your resume aloud and fix one weak line.
Practise a firm handshake and eye contact in a mirror.
Prepare 3 questions to ask the interviewer.
Practise Tell me about a challenge you faced.
Learn the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
Answer Describe a time you worked in a team, using STAR.
Choose what to wear for an interview and why.
Practise your answer to Why this company?
Prepare your answer on salary expectations.
Do a 3-minute mock interview with a friend.
Write a thank-you note you would send after an interview.
Practise answering What are your hobbies?
Prepare for a group discussion: pick a topic and 3 points.
Practise starting a group discussion confidently.
Learn how to disagree politely in a discussion.
Check your LinkedIn headline and photo.
Practise answering Tell me about your final-year project.
Prepare honest answers about gaps or low marks.
Give a 1-minute talk on your favourite subject.
Prepare for one technical question in your subject.
Practise a video interview: light, sound and background.
Do a full mock interview and note 3 improvements.
Fix those 3 improvements and repeat your weakest answer.
Write your top 5 answers on one page for revision.

challenges.title: Typing speed
challenges.line: From slow to 30 words a minute
tasks: Find your starting speed: type for 1 minute.
Home row: a s d f j k l ; for 5 minutes.
Top row: q w e r t y u i o p for 5 minutes.
Bottom row: z x c v b n m for 5 minutes.
Practise the space bar and the shift keys.
Type 10 easy words without looking at the keys.
Type the alphabet 5 times, slowly and correctly.
Number row: 1 to 0 for 5 minutes.
Type one paragraph, accuracy first.
Speed test: 1 minute. Note your speed.
Practise common words: the, and, that, with, have.
Type 5 short sentences without errors.
Punctuation: comma, full stop, question mark.
Capital letters and shift: 5 minutes.
Type your own name and address 5 times, fast.
Type a paragraph while watching only the screen.
Practise double letters: letter, apple, school.
Practise the hard keys: p, q, z, x.
Speed test: 1 minute. Beat day 10.
Type a short email of 5 lines.
Copy a news paragraph in 3 minutes.
Practise symbols: @ # % & ( ).
Type for 5 minutes without checking your hands.
Speed test: 2 minutes, accuracy over 95%.
Type a resume paragraph without looking at the keys.
Type for 5 minutes, fixing errors as you go.
Type for 5 minutes without fixing, then fix at the end.
Speed test: 1 minute. Aim for 30 words a minute.
Type a one-page letter and fix errors at the end.
Final speed test. Compare it with day 1.
